lore.bio:
Mirage is the kind of guy who likes to stand out. The youngest of four brothers, he perfected the art of fooling around to get attention. The one thing he took seriously was Holo-Pilot technology: introduced to the illusion-creating tech by his engineer mother, he poured over the mechanisms and learned all he could about them. Even when his brothers went MIA during the Outlands’ Civil War, Mirage and his mother continued to develop holo devices, and the work brought them closer.
While working as a bartender to make ends meet, Mirage heard amazing stories from his patrons about the Apex Games and the wealth and glory that came with victory. As good as both of those sounded, he knew he couldn’t risk leaving his mother childless – until she gave him a set of customized holo devices and told him to follow his dream. Mirage is now the life of the Apex Games, outwitting opponents and charming audiences across the Outlands, in front of cameras for the world - and his mother - to see.

For more information on Mirage's story, see Mirage (character).

passive.name: Now You See Me...
passive.description: Automatically cloak when using  Respawn Beacons and reviving teammates. Spawn a decoy and cloak when downed.

tactical.name: Psyche Out
tactical.description: Send out a holographic decoy to confuse the enemy. Press ⧄ to control the decoy.

ultimate.name: Life of the Party
ultimate.description: Mirage deploys a team of controllable decoys to distract enemies.

details: Increases decoys spawned from  Life of the Party from 5 to 6.
Decoy health bars no longer appear with  Assault Class Scan.

Now You See Me...:
Now also cloaks when using a healing consumable item
Cloak is removed by damage, ability use, or dropping the heal action
Cloak has a 5 sec cooldown that begins after exiting the cloaked state
Entering cloak now only takes 1s (was 1.5s)
After a revive, Mirage now has increased speed while cloaked

Upgrades: Level 2
Battpack: removed
More Me: removed
NEW Boozle-Eye: Bamboozles now also scan the target who shot the clone
NEW Renaissance Man: gain access to all other Classes’ world interactions: Assault Bins, Care Package scans, Survey Beacons, and Ring Consoles
Mirage and his team will ONLY gain EVO for these interactions if the squad also has a member of that class

Psyche Out
Improved issues against terrain that would cause destruction/floating
Any destroyed by terrain will now be refunded
Improved to more correctly copy the ADS state of the player
No longer mimic reviving or execution animations
(Undocumented) Removed blur effect when looking at a cloaked Mirage through optics.
Class changed from  Skirmisher to  Support.
Class changed from  Offensive to  Skirmisher.

Now You See Me...
Mirage and his ally now remain cloaked after a revive for 3s
Weapons remain stowed while cloaked
Drawing your weapon will remove the cloaking effect early

Psyche Out
Bamboozles are now only triggered by bullet fire and melee
Enemies who are bamboozled now receive notification on their screen
Bamboozle icon marker now tracks the Bamboozled player's movement
Bamboozle icon marker duration increased from 2.5s to 3.5s
Mirage Decoys will now be scanned by Valk when skydiving.
Mirage Decoys will now be picked up by Seer’s Heart Seeker.
Fixed a bug where Mirage Decoys were picked up by Seer’s Exhibit as AI and not players.
Can now use decoys from Valk  Skydive Re-Deploy.
Decoys no longer die after a tick of  Thermite Grenade damage.
Now You See Me...: Cloaked respawn is now disabled if silenced by Revenant.
Decoys now make footstep sounds.
Fixed an issue with the Boogie Down skin blocking vision while aiming down sights and releasing a decoy at the same time.
Psyche Out/ Life of the Party: Decoys now have 45 HP.
Fixed an issue that prevented Mirage decoys from being pinged.
Fixed an issue that did not allow Crypto’s drone to highlight decoys.

Psyche Out:
You can now hold the tactical button and release it to auto-control decoys.
Decoys will now say lines when shot.
Fixed an issue where Mirage can still control his decoy after being silenced by Revenant.
Now You See Me... and  Life of the Party: When cloaked, Mirage's Holo Emitters will be visible to players that are less than 5 meters away.
Now You See Me...: Now disabled if silenced by Revenant.
Skydive: Will now create decoys for the entire squad when skydiving when still diving with your squad.
Fixed an issue with Prowlers not killing decoys in one swipe.
Fixed an issue with decoys not being able to ping correctly under certain conditions.
Fixed an issue with decoys not being able to crouch walk through certain areas.
Fixed an issue with decoys playing the fall animation when the player is falling.
Mirage’s “You got Bamboozled” line will now trigger when you bamboozle an enemy, instead of when you release a decoy.

Psyche Out:
Pressing the character utility action button allows Mirage to gain control of his decoy.
When controlling the decoy, it will mimic Mirage’s every move.
Decoys now last for 60 seconds. (Increased from 15)
Releasing another decoy will remove the previous decoy.

Ultimate:
Life of the Party now replaces Vanishing Act.
Mirage deploys a team of decoys that mimic his every move, instead of stand still.
Reduced cloak time from 5 seconds to 1 second.
Reduced cooldown from 150 seconds to 60 seconds.

Passive:
Changed name from Encore! to Now You See Me…
In addition to cloaking when downed, Mirage also cloaks while using a respawn beacon and reviving a teammate (the teammate is also cloaked).
Psyche Out: Reverted cooldown back to 15 seconds from 25.
Psyche Out: Increased cooldown from 15 seconds to 25 (proven to be accidental).
Encore!: Decoys will now go where directed when deploying them during the drop if Mirage isn’t the Jumpmaster.
Vanishing Act: Can now cancel out of his ultimate cloak early after a small delay.
Vanishing Act: Fixed bug where cloaked Mirage was too noticeable.
Fixed issue with Mirage Ability causing crashes.
